src: “Tattha passitvāhaṃ deve, ekantaṃ sukhasamappite; Taṃ saggagamanatthāya, sīlabbataṃ samādiyiṃ.
tgt: “There having seen the Devā, who were completely given to happiness; To go to that heaven, I undertook observance of the precepts.

src: “Abhijātā sukhumālā, khattiyā caturo janā; Visamaṃ samaṃ akkamantā, vaṅkaṃ gacchāma pabbataṃ.
tgt: “Well-born delicate ones, the four khattiyā people; Walking on the uneven-even [path], we were going to the Vaṅka mountain.
